purpose: Evaluate useful descriptive analysis, not truth policing of source posts.
scale: 0 absent/wrong; 1 generic or major omissions; 2 partial; 3 good and concrete; 4 excellent and supported
protocol: Fresh agents receive identical skill version, dataset and task without rubric answers or expected findings. Record requested model/effort, outputs, score rationale and failures. Revise for demonstrated failures, rerun affected combinations, and test a held-out fixture. Passing a finite matrix is not universal reliability.
